beats.headline: The only one who finds the traps
beats.text: Bobby D.J. Level 24 Spy, rogue class, human, early twenties. An eye twitch; a left hand that does not stop trembling; a stutter. His quadrant is a maze of traps, and he appears to be his party's only rogue, which makes him its first line of defense. His party keeps getting water-breathing scrolls and scrolls of disarm trap. Told that Carl was going to kick his ass, he sits down anyway. Asked whether Carl will murder them: the d-d-day isn't over yet.

beats.headline: The tomb raiders, so called
beats.text: Subject kept the Human race and took the rogue-type Spy Class, and he is one of the two in his party with Desperado Club access. His party holds the subterranean quadrant of their bubble. Carl calls them the tomb raiders, which is not their name for themselves and is the one that stuck.

beats.headline: Mr. Banana and the flesh weasels
beats.text: Subject and a crawler named Mike, who is dressed as a banana, gather several water-breathing scrolls and leave the saferooms at the top of the subterranean quadrant. In a water-filled tunnel they set off a trap. A tube shoots from the wall, pierces Mike's stomach, and fills him with Finger-sized Flesh Weasels, which eat him from the inside out. Subject retreats quickly. The rest of the party stays in its saferooms, paralyzed, waiting for somebody else to drain the place.

beats.headline: Crushed in the tomb
beats.text: Crawler Bobby has been eliminated in the necropolis. He had already told the quest chat he was done, that it was too much, and he was still possessed by a ghost when two of his teammates scratched theirs out on Crawler Carl's advice. The three survivors of the tomb raiders were scattered through the crypt by then, and two of them were on a job for Carl. The tomb has crushers in it; Janice had already walked into one. Morris Sp reports Bobby gone. Cause of death, as reported: crushed.
